finding_text: Encephalitis was documented in 5 of 2245 cases (0.23%), presenting with altered mental status, confusion, and sometimes seizures, with unclear pathophysiology involving possible direct viral invasion or immune-mediated mechanisms.
provenance_quote: Encephalitis, a severe inflammatory condition affecting the brain, was documented in 5 cases (0.23%) [15, 16, 18, 22]. Patients presented with altered mental status, confusion, and in some cases, seizures. The pathophysiology of Mpox virus-related encephalitis remains unclear, but direct viral invasion or immune-mediated mechanisms are potential contributors.

finding_text: S. aureus was identified as the pathogen in this patient's recurrent osteomyelitis and soft tissue infections, consistent with a prior retrospective cohort identifying S. aureus as the most prevalent pathogen in CIPA patients, though this patient's strain was methicillin-sensitive rather than methicillin-resistant as seen in 48.5% of that cohort.
provenance_quote: In agreement with a previous report from a retrospective cohort study that identified S. aureus as the most prevalent pathogen isolated in CIPA patients, our patient also exhibited recurrent S. aureus infection. However, in contrast to 48.5% of cases reported as methicillin-resistant in their study, our patient's strain was methicillin-sensitive [22].

finding_text: In an analysis of 2900 diabetic subjects (Vinik et al.), presence of CAN defined by an abnormal Ewing's test was associated with a 2.14-fold relative risk of death, rising to 3.65-fold if CAN was defined by more than 2 abnormal autonomic function tests.
provenance_quote: Vinik et al. showed that the subset of those with CAN (defined by an abnormal Ewing’s test) had a significant 2.14 relative risk of death, even escalating up to 3.65 if CAN was defined by the presence of more than 2 abnormal quantitative autonomic function tests [5], thereby showing a clear relationship between CAN severity and mortality.

finding_text: A cited study found a significantly higher prevalence of left common iliac vein compression in females with POTS (69%) compared to controls (40%), suggesting POTS patients with pelvic venous congestion symptoms should be evaluated for venous outflow obstruction.
provenance_quote: A recent study assessing the prevalence of venous insufficiency in POTS patients found significant left common iliac vein compression in a majority of POTS patients, with 69% prevalence among females with POTS compared to 40% among controls, suggesting that POTS patients with PVC symptoms should be assessed for venous outflow obstruction.

finding_text: A retrospective 24-hour blood pressure monitoring study in children with CCHS found a higher-than-expected prevalence of hypertension (33%), with PARM genotypes associated with higher rates of elevated blood pressure/hypertension than NPARM genotypes.
provenance_quote: A retrospective study enrolled children with CCHS and monitored their blood pressure over 24 h. The prevalence of hypertension (33%) was higher than expected. CCHS genotype influenced elevated blood pressure and hypertension rates, with higher prevalence in those with severe polyalanine repeat mutations (PARMs) versus NPARM genotypes.

finding_text: Encephalomyelitis presentations included confusion, weakness, and autonomic dysfunction, suggesting multifocal CNS involvement in Mpox infection.
provenance_quote: Encephalomyelitis was observed in 5 individuals (0.23%) [14, 21, 23, 26]. This condition, characterized by inflammation of both the brain and spinal cord, can lead to motor and sensory deficits. Clinical presentations varied from confusion and weakness to autonomic dysfunction, suggesting multifocal involvement.

finding_text: The patient developed Raynaud's-like finger pain in cold weather that persisted for about 30 years despite beta-blocker therapy, consistent with the ~16% prevalence of Raynaud's phenomenon reported among POTS patients in a large cohort.
provenance_quote: Shaw et al. [5] reported only 16% (N = 610) of POTS patients had Raynaud's phenomenon, which was also present in our patient and persisted for about 30 years even after being on continuous medication with metoprolol, a beta-blocker, as these medications have no role in controlling excessive vasoconstriction.

finding_text: A cited study found that 19% of asymptomatic individuals demonstrate spinal abnormalities on MRI, with higher prevalence in those aged 40 or older compared to younger individuals (28% vs 14%).
provenance_quote: Boden and colleagues report that 19 percent of asymptomatic individuals demonstrate spinal abnormalities using magnetic resonance imaging (32). Furthermore, asymptomatic spinal abnormalities are observed more in study participants age 40 and greater than in individuals younger than age 40 (28% vs. 14%) (32).

finding_text: About 25% of dengue-associated GBS patients required mechanical ventilation for respiratory failure, and these patients had markedly worse outcomes than non-ventilated patients.
provenance_quote: Fourteen patients (25% of the cohort) required mechanical ventilation due to respiratory failure. Among these ventilated patients, outcomes were markedly poorer: only 1 of the 14 made a full recovery, 8 had partial recovery with significant residual deficits, and 5 had poor outcomes, including all 3 deaths.

finding_text: In a phase III trial of nivolumab alone or combined with ipilimumab for melanoma, common GI adverse events (diarrhoea, nausea, vomiting) were reported, but no cases of constipation or pseudo-obstruction were noted.
provenance_quote: In one phase III trial assessing the efficacy and safety of nivolumab alone or nivolumab combined with ipilimumab for the treatment of melanoma, diarrhoea was reported in 19.2-44.1%, nausea in 13.1-25.9%, vomiting in 6.4-15.3% patients, but there were no reports of constipation or pseudo-obstruction [14].

finding_text: Transverse myelitis, identified in 2 cases (0.09%), presented with limb weakness, numbness, and bowel/bladder dysfunction, suggesting a potential post-infectious autoimmune response.
provenance_quote: Transverse myelitis, a rare inflammatory disorder of the spinal cord, was identified in 2 cases (0.09%) [13, 18]. Affected individuals experienced limb weakness, numbness, and bowel or bladder dysfunction. The presence of myelitis in Mpox infection suggests a potential post-infectious autoimmune response.

finding_text: In prior literature, 43.3% (20/46) of anti-IgLON5 disease patients showed clinical improvement with immunotherapy, and combination therapy achieved a higher improvement rate (66.6%, 14/21) than monotherapy (31.8%, 7/22).
provenance_quote: A previous report found that 43.3% (20/46) of patients with anti-IgLON5 disease showed clinical improvement with immunotherapy, including steroids, IVIG, PLEX, AZA, and mycophenolate mofetil. Combination therapy showed a higher rate of improvement [14/21 (66.6%)] than monotherapy [7/22 (31.8%)] (6).

finding_text: Mayo Clinic data show that approximately 20% of patients with newly diagnosed AL amyloidosis die within six months, a rate largely unchanged over four decades due to diagnostic delay.
provenance_quote: Early mortality data from the Mayo Clinic indicate that approximately or equal to 20% of patients with newly diagnosed AL amyloidosis succumb within six months, a figure essentially unchanged over the past four decades and a stark reminder that diagnostic delay remains largely unmitigated (11).

finding_text: In a cohort of 107 alcoholism patients versus 61 controls, 24.3% had autonomic neuropathy and 32% had peripheral neuropathy, supporting a dose-dependent toxic effect of alcohol on nerves.
provenance_quote: They found that 26 patients (24.3%) had autonomic neuropathy and 34 (32%) had peripheral neuropathy. They concluded that autonomic and peripheral neuropathies are common among patients with alcoholism, and that alcohol is toxic to both autonomic and peripheral nerves in a dose-dependent manner.

finding_text: A phase III trial comparing pembrolizumab versus ipilimumab in advanced melanoma reported GI adverse events including diarrhoea, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, and constipation, none of which reached grade 3-5 severity.
provenance_quote: Another phase III study comparing pembrolizumab versus ipilimumab for the treatment of advanced melanoma reported similar adverse events including diarrhoea (16.9-22.7%), nausea (10.1-11.2%), and vomiting (1.8-5.5%), and also abdominal pain (1.8-5.9%) and constipation (1.8-2.5%) [15].

finding_text: A tertiary referral center survey found that most patients with orthostasis had diabetic neuropathy/paraneoplastic causes or primary autonomic failure, while over a third had no evidence of generalized autonomic dysfunction.
provenance_quote: In a survey conducted at a tertiary referral center, 38% of patients with orthostasis exhibited no evidence of generalized autonomic dysfunction, 35% had diabetic neuropathy or paraneoplastic syndromes as probable causes of autonomic failure, and 27% had primary autonomic failure [8].

finding_text: 77% of POTS patients were told they had a psychiatric or psychological problem prior to diagnosis, compared with only 28% who actually reported a psychiatric or psychological condition.
provenance_quote: In addition, a high percentage (77%) of participants reported being told they were suffering from a psychiatric or psychological problem before their POTS diagnosis [7]. However, in contrast, only 1247 (28%) respondents reported suffering from a psychiatric or psychological problem.

finding_text: In a prior study of patients undergoing CNA for reflex asystolic syncope, symptomatic post-procedural sinus tachycardia occurred in 27% of patients, with 7% requiring long-term beta-blocker and/or ivabradine therapy for up to 18 months.
provenance_quote: In a recently published study in patients with reflex asystolic syncope referred for CNA, symptomatic post-procedural persistent or paroxysmal sinus tachycardia was present in 27% of patients and 7% of them required long-term beta-blocker and/or ivabradine therapy up to 18 months

finding_text: In 28 male patients with alcoholism, significant polyneuropathy was found with a delay in parasympathetic parameters compared to controls.
provenance_quote: Another study by Matikainen et al. [5] was performed on 28 male patients with alcoholism revealing significant polyneuropathy with neurophysiological findings in 7% of subjects. A delay in parasympathetic parameters could be detected in the alcoholics compared with controls.

finding_text: A 10-year Mayo Clinic retrospective study of 53 CASPR2-IgG-seropositive patients found the clinical phenotype typically comprised a triad of CNS features, autonomic instability, and peripheral nerve hyperexcitability, with 15% of seizure patients showing coexisting PNS involvement.
provenance_quote: According to a 10-year retrospective study on 53 CASPR2-IgG-seropositive patients at Mayo Clinic Neuroimmunology [17], the clinical phenotype of CASPR2 encephalitis typically encompasses a triad of CNS features, autonomic instability, and peripheral nerve hyperexcitability.

finding_text: In a cited cohort, 31% of GBS patients experienced autonomic dysfunction, manifesting as hypertension (84.8%), hypotension (76.1%), tachycardia (76.1%), gastrointestinal dysmotility (76.1%), and need for vasopressor drugs (58.7%).
provenance_quote: Bazán-Rodríguez et al. (2023) showed that 31% of GBS patients experienced autonomic dysfunction, with manifestations including hypertension (84.8%), hypotension (76.1%), tachycardia (76.1%), gastrointestinal dysmotility (76.1%), and the need for vasopressor drugs (58.7%).

finding_text: A large national cohort study in England (Muller et al.) found no increase in long-term incidence of autoimmune disease among women receiving a synthetic mid-urethral mesh sling compared with non-mesh surgery.
provenance_quote: Similarly, a recent large national cohort study in England by Muller et al. found no increase in long-term incidence of autoimmune disease among women receiving a synthetic mid-urethral mesh sling compared with non-mesh surgery (adjusted HR 0.89, 95 % CI 0.79–1.01) [11].

finding_text: In a non-blinded trial of adolescents with POTS, midodrine 2.5 mg once daily was superior to metoprolol 0.5 mg/kg daily or increased salt and water intake, with 89% efficacy over 3-6 months of follow-up.
provenance_quote: In a non-blinded trial of adolescents with POTS, midodrine at 2.5 mg once daily was proven to be superior to metoprolol 0.5 mg/kg daily or increased salt and water intake, with 89% efficacy during three to six months of follow-up despite the very low dose used [20,21].

finding_text: A multicenter retrospective study of 25 patients with CASPR2 antibody-associated encephalitis found cognitive disturbance in 68%, limbic encephalitis in 32%, and seizures in 24% of cases.
provenance_quote: In a multicenter retrospective study involving 25 patients with CASPR2 antibody-associated encephalitis, cognitive disturbance was the most frequent symptom, observed in 68% of cases. Limbic encephalitis was diagnosed in 32%, and seizures occurred in 24% of patients.

finding_text: A cited investigation found that 69% of patients with POTS had significant (>50%) left common iliac vein compression compared to 40% of age-matched healthy controls.
provenance_quote: Recently, there has been an investigation into the overlap between venous disease and orthostatic intolerance with 69% of patients with POTS found to have significant (>50%) left common iliac vein compression compared to 40% of age-matched healthy controls [2].

finding_text: A cited whiplash-trauma study found that the presence of two or more imaging findings (lateral overhang >2mm and periodontoid asymmetry) had 79% specificity for predicting cervical injury.
provenance_quote: one study of patients with whiplash trauma found that when two or more imaging findings were present such as a lateral overhang exceeding 2 mm and periodontoid asymmetry, there was a specificity of 79% for predicting injury versus absence of injury [10].

finding_text: A case-control study found that 67% of gangrenous cholecystitis patients presented with relatively mild, subacute symptoms and had a longer delay to admission compared with patients with uncomplicated acute cholecystitis.
provenance_quote: In their case-control study, Contini et al. found that 67% of patients with GC had relatively mild, subacute symptoms at initial presentation, and were more likely to have a longer delay to admission than patients with uncomplicated acute cholecystitis.

finding_text: A previous study of 96 GBS patients with autonomic dysfunction reported cardiovascular complication rates of tachycardia (26.04%), bradycardia (13.54%), labile hypertension (12.5%), and fluctuating heart rate (11.46%).
provenance_quote: A previous study of cardiovascular complications in autonomic dysfunction related to GBS reported that tachycardia (26.04%), bradycardia (13.54%), labile hypertension (12.5%), and fluctuating heart rate (11.46%) were common among a total of 96 patients.

finding_text: Vitamin B12 deficiency is reported to occur in more than 20% of older adults over age 60, and is highly prevalent in the vegetarian Indian population, including one study finding 86.7% deficiency among patients with coronary artery disease.
provenance_quote: In fact, Mahalle et al. [23] found that 86.7% of their study patients were deficient in vitamin B12 and had suffered from coronary artery disease. Singla et al. [24] also reported a 47% prevalence of vitamin B12 deficiency in a North Indian population.

finding_text: In a German cohort, 8.4% of PHASA patients experienced headache tied to a specific intercourse position, while 51% reported symptom relief by adopting a more passive role or keeping the neck lower than the trunk.
provenance_quote: In a German cohort, 8.4% of patients experienced headache during a specific position of sexual intercourse, while 51% reported alleviation of the headache by assuming a more passive role during sexual activity or keeping the neck lower than the trunk.

finding_text: Reflex syncope was the most common type of cardiovascular autonomic disorder identified during the acute phase of SARS-CoV-2 infection.
provenance_quote: Reflex syncope was the most common cardiovascular autonomic disorder in the acute phase (p = 0.008) and postural orthostatic tachycardia syndrome (POTS) the most frequent diagnosis in individuals with post-COVID-19 orthostatic complaints (p < 0.001).

finding_text: IVIG was the most commonly used immunotherapy for dengue-associated GBS, administered in 76.7% of cases, with immunotherapy overall (IVIG or plasma exchange) used in 89.2% of cases.
provenance_quote: Immunotherapy, including either plasma exchange or intravenous immunoglobulin (IVIG), was utilized in 89.2% of cases. IVIG was the most common treatment, administered in about 76.7% of all cases, and 2 cases were managed by supportive therapy only.

finding_text: A cited large observational study found anti-LGI1 antibody sensitivity in CSF (100%) was higher than in serum (92%), consistent with this patient's CSF-positive, serum-negative result.
provenance_quote: Although it was initially thought that the CSF titer of LGI1 antibody is only 1 out of 10 in the serum, a more recent large observational study has reported that the sensitivity of LGI1 antibody in the CSF is higher (100%) than in the serum (92%).

finding_text: A study analyzing circulating viral antigens in 706 participants found a correlation between at least one long COVID symptom and a positive antigen test in 43% of participants, though positive antigens were also detected in 21% of asymptomatic participants.
provenance_quote: A correlation between at least one long COVID symptom and detecting a positive antigen in blood samples was found in 43% of the participants. However, they could also detect circulating viral antigens in 21% of participants with no symptoms (29).

finding_text: In a case-control study, LPS levels were positively correlated with clinical symptoms in ME/CFS patients compared to matched healthy controls.
provenance_quote: Similar results were reported by Martín et al. (9), who compared LPS levels in 30 patients with ME/CFS and 26 matched healthy controls, revealing a positive correlation between clinical symptoms and increased LPS levels (r = 0.89; P < 0.001).

finding_text: Cranial nerve involvement was common in dengue-associated GBS: facial nerve (VII) palsy in 32%, bulbar weakness in 28.6%, and oculomotor palsy in 9.8% of cases.
provenance_quote: About one-third of the cases (32%) had associated facial nerve (cranial nerve VII) palsy, and roughly 28.6% had bulbar weakness such as dysarthria and dysphagia from lower cranial nerve involvement. Oculomotor palsy was less common (9.8%).

finding_text: Axonal GBS variants (AMSAN and AMAN combined) accounted for roughly 46% of dengue-associated GBS cases, more than typically expected in Western GBS cohorts.
provenance_quote: For GBS subtype, the axonal variants were prominent: acute motor axonal neuropathy (AMAN) and acute motor and sensory axonal neuropathy (AMSAN) together accounted for roughly 46% of cases (19 AMSAN cases [33.9%] and 7 AMAN cases [12.5%]).

finding_text: Wang et al. found a 32-fold greater prevalence of MCAS in dysautonomic patients with both POTS and hypermobile EDS compared to those without those comorbidities.
provenance_quote: Wang et al. found a 32-fold greater prevalence of MCAS in a subpopulation of 195 dysautonomic patients who specifically had POTS and hypermobile Ehlers–Danlos syndrome (hEDS) compared to the subpopulation without those comorbidities [34]

finding_text: A cited study found that 27% of patients with acute myocarditis had T-wave inversion, which correlated with areas of transmural edema on cardiac MRI, suggesting underlying myocardial injury as a mechanism for TWI.
provenance_quote: One study found that 27% of patients with acute myocarditis had TWI. Moreover, the TWI correlated with areas of transmural edema on cardiac MRI (CMR), which suggests an underlying myocardial injury as a cause of these ECG changes [11].

finding_text: Limb weakness or paralysis was observed in 9 of 2245 individuals (0.4%), attributed to direct viral effects, immune-mediated inflammation, or post-infectious complications like myelitis or GBS.
provenance_quote: Limb weakness or paralysis was observed in 9 individuals (0.4%) [13, 21]23– [16, 24]. The underlying causes varied, including direct viral effects, immune-mediated inflammation, and post-infectious complications like myelitis or GBS.

finding_text: Fatigue was the most common neurological manifestation reported, occurring in 732 of 2245 individuals (32.6%).
provenance_quote: Fatigue was reported in 732 individuals (32.6%), making it the most common neurological manifestation. This symptom likely reflects a combination of viral illness, immune activation, and possible central nervous system involvement.

finding_text: Overall prognosis of dengue-associated GBS was favorable, with 57% achieving full recovery, 32% partial recovery, and 5.4% mortality across the 56-case cohort.
provenance_quote: A majority, 57% (32 patients), achieved full recovery, regaining essentially normal neurologic function by the time of the last follow-up. Among these, 26 had documented recovery times, with a median of 23 days (range: 5–365 days).

finding_text: Across prior series, sinus node-sparing hybrid ablation has been associated with less than 5% pacemaker implantation, less than 10% redo endocardial procedure rate, and no chronic symptomatic phrenic nerve palsy up to 5-year follow-up, outcomes considered more favorable than conventional endocardial sinus node modification/ablation.
provenance_quote: Moreover, recently SN sparing has beed documented to results in only less than 5% of pacemaker implantation, less than 10% of redo endocardial procedure and no chronic symptomatic phrenic nerve palsy up to 5-year follow-up [7].

finding_text: Dengue-related thrombocytopenia, present in 43% of cases, was associated with a higher rate of ICU admission compared with normal platelet counts.
provenance_quote: Among patients who developed thrombocytopenia during their DENV infection, a greater proportion required ICU care (10 out of 24 patients, 41.7%) compared to those with normal platelet counts (6 out of 15 patients, 40.0%).

finding_text: A cited study found that CSF IgG4 concentration above 2.27 mg/dL identified all cases of IgG4-related hypertrophic pachymeningitis while misclassifying only 5% of other hypertrophic pachymeningitis cases, and an IgG4Loc index cutoff of 0.47 perfectly distinguished the two groups.
provenance_quote: CSF IgG4 levels exceeding 2.27 mg/dL successfully identified 100% of IgG4-HP cases and 5% of OHP cases. Additionally, an IgG4Loc cutoff value of 0.47 distinguished 100% of IgG4-HP cases without identifying any OHP cases.

finding_text: Full recovery rates varied by GBS subtype, being highest in AMSAN (73.7%), followed by AIDP (57.1%) and AMAN (42.9%), while partial recovery predominated in AMAN (57.1%).
provenance_quote: Recovery outcomes varied by electrophysiological subtype. Full recovery was most frequent in AMSAN (73.7%, 14/19), followed by AIDP (57.1%, 8/14) and AMAN (42.9%, 3/7). Partial recovery predominated in AMAN (57.1%, 4/7).

finding_text: A post hoc exploratory analysis found HPV vaccination was associated with increased risk of POTS compared with control/placebo groups.
provenance_quote: a post hoc exploratory analysis of serious harms demonstrated increased harm for HPV vaccines, both for POTS (56 vs. 26, relative risk (RR) 1.92 (95% confidence interval (CI) 1.21 to 3.07), NNH 1073, p = 0.006, I2 = 0%)

finding_text: A meta-analysis of 9208 patients found neurological IrAE prevalence of 3.8% with anti-CTLA-4 inhibitors, 6.1% with anti-PD-1 inhibitors, and 12.0% with combination ICI therapy.
provenance_quote: A meta-analysis encompassing 9208 patients revealed a prevalence of 3.8% in those receiving anti-CTLA-4 inhibitors, 6.1% in patients on anti-PD-1 inhibitors, and 12.0% in individuals receiving combination therapy [10].

finding_text: Prior literature (Shellhaas et al.) reports that approximately half of Arnold-Chiari II patients experience sleep-disordered breathing due to a combination of spinal defect level and brainstem/musculoskeletal abnormalities.
provenance_quote: Shellhaas et al. observe that half of the Arnold–Chiari II patients experience sleep-disordered breathing due to a combination of the level of their spinal defect and brainstem and musculoskeletal abnormalities [19].

finding_text: A 2022 meta-analysis of 69 children with SWS reported prenatal manifestations including short/curved long bones (32%), intrauterine growth restriction (17%), and oligohydramnios (16%).
provenance_quote: A 2022 meta-analysis of 69 children with SWS showed a median age of 32 months [3]. Prenatal manifestations included short and curved long bones (32%), intrauterine growth restriction (17%), and oligohydramnios (16%).

finding_text: An endoscopic biopsy study of 46 IBD patients approximately 7 months after mild acute COVID-19 demonstrated persistent viral nucleocapsid protein within gut epithelium and CD8+ T cells in over half of patients, and detectable SARS-CoV-2 RNA in most patients, supporting a viral persistence mechanism in long COVID.
provenance_quote: The study demonstrated persistent viral nucleocapsid protein within the gut epithelium and CD8+ T cells in 52% of patients (24 out of 46) and detected SARS-CoV-2 RNA expression in 69% of patients (32 out of 46) (31).

finding_text: In the Phase 3 POLARIX trial, the R-pola-CHP regimen (substituting Polatuzumab vedotin for Vincristine) showed similar overall survival to R-CHOP but superior two-year progression-free and event-free survival.
provenance_quote: In the Phase 3 POLARIX trial, R-pola-CHP was associated with similar overall survival compared to R-CHOP. However, the 77% two-year progression-free survival and two-year event-free survival were superior to R-CHOP.

finding_text: Prior cohort data show more than a twofold increase in the frequency of anti-Ma2 encephalitis following the introduction of immune checkpoint inhibitors, with mortality exceeding 50% despite multimodal immunotherapy.
provenance_quote: Vogrig et al. reported a more than twofold increase in the frequency of anti-Ma2 encephalitis following the introduction of ICIs, with cases observed across multiple tumor types, including pleural mesothelioma (3).

finding_text: In a cited cohort of 77 patients with elevated TS-HDS antibodies, only 66% had neuropathy, most commonly length-dependent peripheral neuropathy, length-dependent SFN, or non-length-dependent SFN.
provenance_quote: In a study of 77 patients with elevated TS-HDS antibodies, only 66% had neuropathy, most commonly length-dependent peripheral neuropathy (n=20), length-dependent SFN (n=11), or non-length-dependent SFN (n=7) [8].

finding_text: Headache affected 657 of 2245 individuals (29.2%), often in early infection alongside fever and fatigue.
provenance_quote: Headache was one of the most frequently reported neurological symptoms, affecting 657 individuals (29.2%). It often appeared in the early stages of infection and was commonly associated with fever and fatigue.

finding_text: Women were more frequently represented among post-COVID-19 cardiovascular autonomic dysfunction cases compared to acute-phase cases.
provenance_quote: Post-COVID-19 cases were younger than those with cardiovascular autonomic disturbances in the acute SARS-CoV-2 phase (42 vs. 51 years old, p = 0.002) and were more frequently women (68% vs. 49%, p = 0.034).

finding_text: In a referenced cohort of 249 HBAT treatments (74% BoNT/A), symptom improvement began at a median of 2.4 days post-administration and was limited to halting progression rather than accelerating recovery, whereas this BoNT/B patient improved within hours, suggesting toxin serotype may affect antitoxin response speed.
provenance_quote: Data from 249 HBAT treatments showed symptom improvement started on a median of 2.4 days after administration, with benefits limited to stopping botulism progression rather than accelerating recovery [7].

finding_text: A cited 2019 Chinese study found that 48.4% of pediatric POTS patients were symptom-free at one-year follow-up, rising to 85.6% symptom-free after six years.
provenance_quote: A 2019 study of long-term outcomes from China demonstrated that 48.4% of pediatric patients with POTS were free of symptoms at the one-year follow-up, with 85.6% being symptom-free after six years [11].

finding_text: Healthy volunteers confined to bed rest for two weeks developed orthostatic intolerance along with a 17% reduction in plasma volume and a 5% reduction in cardiac mass.
provenance_quote: For instance, one study showed healthy volunteers confined to bed rest for two weeks developed orthostatic intolerance along with a 17% reduction in plasma volume and a 5% reduction in cardiac mass [6].

finding_text: In an updated cohort of 500 ASIA syndrome patients, almost half had symptom onset after vaccine exposure, and 8.4% were exposed specifically to the Tdap vaccine.
provenance_quote: In the updated study, with a cohort of 500 ASIA syndrome patients, almost half of the subjects had a clinical manifestation after vaccine exposure, and 8.4% of them were exposed to the Tdap vaccine.

finding_text: A cited cohort study (Singh et al.) found autonomic dysfunction in 41.53% of GBS patients, with constipation and diarrhea being the most common manifestations, followed by urinary retention and blood pressure/heart rate fluctuations.
provenance_quote: A study conducted by Singh et al. found that 41.53% of GBS patients experienced autonomic dysfunction, with constipation (22%) and diarrhea (21.2%) being the most prevalent manifestations [10].

finding_text: The UK COVID-19 Symptom Study smartphone app data indicated that approximately 10% of people testing positive for SARS-CoV-2 remain unwell beyond 3 weeks, consistent with a long COVID phenotype.
provenance_quote: The UK COVID-19 symptom study, based on self-input of symptoms into a smartphone app, reported that approximately 10% of patients who test positive for SARS-CoV-2 remain unwell beyond 3 weeks.

finding_text: In a smaller U.K. cohort of young elite athletes, 14% experienced symptoms lasting more than 28 days after COVID-19 infection, and 27% were unable to return to full sports participation at 1 month.
provenance_quote: However, in a smaller U.K. cohort, 14% of young elite athletes experienced symptoms >28 days, and 27% were unable to return to full sports participation at 1 month following initial infection.

finding_text: Among patients who underwent surgery for pineal/tectal lesions, the majority had improved or resolved symptoms postoperatively.
provenance_quote: Of the 200 (55%) patients who underwent surgery, 135 patients (67.5%) had improved or resolved symptoms post-operatively, including 120 patients with improved autonomic dysfunction symptoms.

finding_text: In a prior series of 404 adult GBS cases, approximately 3.2% (13 patients) experienced recurrent episodes, indicating relapse occurs in a minority of patients.
provenance_quote: In a previous report showing a series of 404 adult GBS cases, approximately 3.2% (13 patients) experienced recurrent episodes, indicating that relapse occurs in a minority of patients (10).

finding_text: A Mayo Clinic study found organ-specific autoantibodies in POTS patients and estimated that about 33% of POTS cases have an autoimmune basis, with autoantibodies targeting cardiac and vascular adrenergic receptors.
provenance_quote: Another study conducted at the Mayo Clinic found organ-specific autoantibodies in POTS patients; furthermore, their results support that about 33% of POTS cases have an autoimmune basis.

finding_text: In a cohort of 300 ASIA syndrome patients, 119 had vaccines (including Tdap) as the only identifiable exposure factor prior to symptom onset.
provenance_quote: In one cohort study with 300 ASIA patients, 119 of them had vaccines as the only exposure factor identified previous to the development of the symptoms, including the Tdap immunization.

finding_text: In a study of POTS patients, 56% had an abnormal QSART result, typically patchy and involving the lower extremity.
provenance_quote: Fifty-six percent (56%) of patients had an abnormal QSART (quantitative sudomotor axon reflex testing), as in this patient. which was typically patchy and involved the lower extremity.

finding_text: In a large cohort study of 4835 POTS patients, patients were predominantly female (80-94%) with a median age of onset around 17 years, and infection was the most commonly reported trigger (41%), followed by surgery, pregnancy, vaccination, and other factors.
provenance_quote: The major causes reported were infection (41%), surgery (12%), pregnancy (9%), vaccination (6%), accident (6%), puberty (5%), post-concussion (4%), and emotional stress or trauma (3%).

finding_text: Across interventional studies (iliac stenting, ovarian/internal-iliac embolization, superficial venous ablation, renal-vein transposition or robotic auto-transplantation), orthostatic symptoms generally improved, with cohorts using the Orthostatic Hypotension Questionnaire showing approximately 50% mean symptom reduction.
provenance_quote: Orthostatic symptoms generally improved; cohorts using the Orthostatic Hypotension Questionnaire showed ∼50% mean reduction, and several stented patients no longer met POTS criteria.

finding_text: In a cited cohort, GAD65 antibodies were found in about 80% of SPS/PERM patients compared with 5% of other neurological disease patients and 1% of healthy controls.
provenance_quote: They reported that GAD65 antibodies were detected in approximately 80% of patients with SPS and PERM, compared with 5% of those with other neurological diseases and 1% of controls.

finding_text: In a large U.S. registry of over 3,500 college athletes with COVID-19 infection, 4.0% experienced exertional cardiopulmonary symptoms on return to exercise, and 1.2% remained symptomatic beyond 21 days.
provenance_quote: A large U.S. registry of >3,500 college athletes showed that 4.0% experienced exertional cardiopulmonary symptoms on return to exercise, and 1.2% were symptomatic beyond 21 days.

provenance_quote: Compared to room air, simulated rebreathing significantly increased standing systolic blood pressure (p = 0.02), stroke volume (p = 0.03), cardiac output (p = 0.02), and MCAv (p = 0.004) (Fig. 1a–c, e), whereas heart rate (p = 0.41) and systemic vascular resistance (p = 0.44) did not differ between conditions (Fig. 1d, e).

finding_text: End-tidal oxygen was, as expected, substantially reduced during simulated rebreathing compared to +CO2 alone, confirming the intended hypoxic-hypercapnic gas manipulation.
